mira-s: Hey team — customer reports intermittent 403 on streaming after ~12-18min. They see `X-Request-ID: rwd-9f3a2` in logs, then connection cuts with no body. Need reproducible curl + headers, and a debug bundle request.

support-bot: Created ticket #INC-4521 and requested debug bundle. Please include the full curl, trace id, and timestamps.

samir: Quick checklist to gather first: 
- exact curl used (full headers)
- server time window (start/end)
- `X-Request-ID` and `redwood-trace-id` from headers
- streaming client logs (client-side reconnects)
- token expiry/rotation timing

samir: Example curl I asked them to try (streaming SSE, show headers + trace):
```bash
export TOKEN=REDACTED
export REQID=rwd-9f3a2

curl -v 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  -H "X-Request-ID: $REQID" 
  -H "User-Agent: support-repro/1.0" 
  --no-buffer \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-alpha" \
  --dump-header response-headers.txt \
  --trace-ascii curl-trace.txt
```
Notes: `-v` + `--dump-header` will capture response headers (we need `X-Request-ID` and any `Set-Cookie` or auth hints). `--trace-ascii` helps show raw bytes and chunk boundaries.

ellie: Also try forcing HTTP/1.1 to match client's runtime: `--http1.1`. If client uses keepalive pooling, try `--no-keepalive` and `--keepalive-time 0` to rule out connection reuse.

samir: If they see immediate 403 after ~12-18min, suspect token TTL or intermediate proxy killing long connections. Ask them to: 
- confirm token TTL remaining at start `exp` claim
- run `tcpdump -w sse.pcap host api.redwood.ai` during repro (optional)
- include system time sync (`date -u`) at start/end

alex: Ran the curl above with `--http1.1` and captured headers. I see a `Set-Cookie: session=...; Max-Age=900` right before the cut, and then a 403. Attaching `response-headers.txt` snippet: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` then later `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` with `X-Request-ID: rwd-9f3a2`.

mira-s: Good catch. Please upload the response header file + `curl-trace.txt` to the incident ticket. Also include the live `redwood-trace-id` if present (we can map to our backend traces).

samir: If they can't reproduce locally, instruct them to do a replay with a short-lived token to simulate expiry: `sleep 100 && curl ...` to hit the boundary. Also show them how to extract headers via `awk`: 
```bash
awk '/^X-Request-ID|^redwood-trace-id|^HTTP/ {print}' response-headers.txt
```

ellie: If streaming uses SSE and client expects comments to keepalive (`: keepalive`), try adding `-H "Prefer: keepalive=1"` (server ignores but may exercise different path).

support-bot: Reminder: for debug bundle we need: request ids, `curl-trace.txt`, response headers, approximate client start/end timestamps, and redwood account/org id. Use the secure upload link in the ticket.

alex: Uploaded bundle to INC-4521, included `response-headers.txt` and `curl-trace.txt`. Also added `system-info.txt` showing `curl 7.88.1` and `OpenSSL 3.0.9`.

mira-s: Thanks. Can ops check for backend trace `rwd-9f3a2` or any correlated `redwood-trace-id` around 2026-03-16T14:12:00Z -> 14:30:00Z?

deploy-bot: Alert: rolling deploy to inference cluster completed at 2026-03-16T14:05:12Z on region-us-west-2.

samir: Deploy timing overlaps customer window — ops please confirm if any connection draining behavior was enabled during the rollout that might return 403 on existing pooled connections.

ellie: Also confirm whether our LB sends `Connection: close` or RST during drain. If yes, client libraries might interpret as 403 depending on proxy.

alex: Ops confirmed no active config to tear down connections, but they saw a spike of 502->403 in the proxy logs matching the request id prefix. They attached proxy log line: `proxy[pid]: upstream returned 403 for req=rwd-9f3a2, reason=auth_refresh_failed`.

mira-s: Next steps: ops to pull full backend trace for `rwd-9f3a2`, engineering to review auth refresh path for streaming tokens, and customer to try the exact curl with `--http1.1 --no-buffer --trace-ascii` and re-upload if it fails.

alex: Customer will run repro at 14:00 PT tomorrow and upload artifacts. I'll leave a short repro checklist in the ticket. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Closing Slack thread; monitoring INC-4521 for bundle.
